blocks.x: Randall’s Island will be home to an enchanting Harry Potter drone celebration this fall — a unique opportunity for Witches, wizards and Muggles alike to bask in the nostalgia of the iconic series.

Your favorite places and characters will take shape in the night sky during a spellbinding drone experience on October 23 and 24, complete with themed food and drinks, merch, and special ‘Dark Arts’ season activations right before muggles ring in Halloween. Grab your tickets today:
A memorable show in the NYC skies

DroneArt Show: Harry Potter doesn’t just etch the wonder of the movies onto the NYC skies; it also creates a real sense of connection between fans and the magic overhead. Before taking in the 1,200 drone fleet, you’ll get to enjoy some Butterbeer, grab a souvenir at the merch stand, and receive an LED wristband that lights up during the show.
Complete with a live electric violinist, the drone spectacle will elevate key moments from the Harry Potter films — breathing new life into the saga you think you know so well.
DroneArt Show: Harry Potter

You’ll want to get there early to enjoy all the pre-show goodness, especially the unique merch this Dark Arts season that includes wands, scarves and collectibles designed for fans of all ages. Getting there early also ensures you pick the best spot on the lawn!
NYC nights can get a bit chilly this time of year, so bring your favorite blanket and cozy up underneath the stars as the drones dance overhead for 60 captivating minutes…

DroneArt Show: Harry Potter
DroneArt Show: Harry Potter reviews
While this will be the very first time the drone show graces NY, it has charmed cities across the globe, gathering over 800,000 attendees. Here’s what some of them had to say:

“Fantastic experience! My wife, our two kids, and I had an amazing time at the Harry Potter drone show by Fever tonight. The drone effects, music, and atmosphere were truly magical, and the kids were completely captivated. Such a fun and memorable family night — highly recommend for any Harry Potter fan!” — David C.
“It was magical, no matter if your 5 or 80 this show is for all ages. Would recommend to anyone. Surprised my husband for the second time and he loved it.” — Pilar P.

“As a true Harry Potter fan, I really appreciated the care and thoughtfulness with the way the whole show was put together. It wasn’t just basic/simple/generic HP pictures with Hedwig’s theme playing in the background – the entire experience was so immersive that it felt like I was watching a movie or a play with the perfect mix of joyful nostalgia and exciting elements I’d never seen before. I teared up several times. I hadn’t felt this happy since I first watched the movies as a kid. And to be able to share it with my 7 year old son tonight – it was nothing short of real magic.” — Lizy S.
About Randall’s Island

Randall’s Island is a picturesque corner of the city, once separated from Ward’s Island by the Little Hell Gate who has since been filled by construction debris. Home to stunning trails and biking paths, the island will be home to this enchanting Harry Potter celebration this fall…
DroneArt Show: Harry Potter

DroneArt Show: Harry Potter will grace the Randall’s Island skyline for just two nights, so make sure to secure your spot for the limited-time event. Bring along friends, family or fellow fans of the films and bask in the nostalgia of the Harry Potter saga this fall…

When: October 23 & 24, 2026
Duration: The drone show will last approximately 60 minutes, including an intermission. Doors will open 2 hours prior to the event start time.
Where: Randall’s Island Park
Parking: on-site parking at the venue.
Ages: All ages
Get your tickets now!
Don’t miss the nostalgic experience!
